description: Incentivizes farmers to switch from water-intensive paddy (rice) cultivation to alternative crops like maize, pulses, cotton, sesame, or horticultural crops to conserve groundwater.
benefits: Financial incentive of ₹7,000 per acre provided directly into the farmer's bank account for replacing paddy with alternative crops.
eligibility: Farmers residing and cultivating land in designated dark zones / groundwater stressed blocks of Haryana
Must register land and crop diversification details on the Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) portal
documents: Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) Registration ID
application_mode: Online via Meri Fasal Mera Byora Portal (fasal.haryana.gov.in)

description: Protects horticulture producers from market price fluctuations by compensating the difference between the protected price set by the government and the actual wholesale market selling price.
benefits: Direct financial compensation for the deficit amount when wholesale market prices fall below the fixed base support price for 21 notified vegetable and fruit crops.
eligibility: Vegetable and fruit growers owning or leasing land in Haryana
Compulsory registration of crop area on the MFMB portal during the notified sowing period
application_mode: Online via Meri Fasal Mera Byora Portal

scheme_name: Agricultural Machinery Subsidy & Crop Residue Management (CRM) Scheme
description: Provides financial subsidy on in-situ and ex-situ crop residue management machinery (Super Seeder, Happy Seeder, Straw Baler, Mulcher) to prevent paddy stubble burning.
benefits: 50% individual subsidy on purchase of stubble management machinery and 80% subsidy for Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) established by Panchayats or Farmer Groups.
eligibility: Individual land-owning farmers, Panchayats, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and Custom Hiring Centers in Haryana
Registration on MFMB portal is mandatory

description: Encourages rice growers to adopt the Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) technique instead of traditional puddled transplantation to save irrigation water and energy.
benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹4,000 per acre deposited into the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibility: Paddy cultivators in Haryana who sow rice directly using DSR machines
Verification of DSR fields conducted by district agriculture officers
application_mode: Online via Meri Fasal Mera Byora Portal

scheme_name: Haryana Pashudhan Bima Yojana & Pashu Kisan Credit Card
description: Provides free or low-cost livestock insurance for cows, buffaloes, sheep, goats, and pigs, along with collateral-free short-term credit cards for animal rearers.
benefits: Free insurance coverage up to ₹80,000 per cattle for BPL families (nominal premium for general categories) and working capital credit line up to ₹1,60,000 without collateral.
eligibility: Livestock rearers residing in Haryana holding valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP)
Animals must be ear-tagged with UID
documents: Ear Tag Number / Livestock Health Certificate
application_mode: Offline via Government Veterinary Hospitals or Banks

description: Offers heavy subsidies to farmers for replacing diesel pumps or installing new off-grid solar powered water pumps (3 HP to 10 HP) for crop irrigation.
benefits: 75% total subsidy (45% state subsidy + 30% central subsidy), with the farmer bearing only 25% of the capital cost.
eligibility: Farmers having land records and existing micro-irrigation systems (drip/sprinkler) or opting for new micro-irrigation setup in Haryana
Preference given to farmers without existing grid electricity connections for farming
application_mode: Online via HAREDA / Saral Haryana Portal (saralharyana.gov.in)

description: Subsidizes high-tech greenhouses, polyhouses, shade-net structures, pack houses, cold storage units, and fruit orchard plantations.
benefits: 50% to 65% capital subsidy for establishing polyhouses, shade nets, micro-irrigation in orchards, and post-harvest infrastructure.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, and agri-entrepreneurs in Haryana registered on the Horticulture Department portal
documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) / Technical Cost Estimate

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Evam Khetihar Mazdoor Jeevan Suraksha Yojana
description: Provides financial compensation to farmers and agricultural laborers in case of accidental death or permanent disability while operating farm machinery.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹5,00,000 in case of death or total disability, and ₹37,500 to ₹2,50,000 for partial disability / loss of limbs during farm operations.
eligibility: All farmers and farm workers aged between 12 and 65 years residing in Haryana
documents: FIR Copy / Police Report of Accident
Post-Mortem Report / Disability Certificate from CMO
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Details of Beneficiary/Nominee
application_mode: Offline / Online via Haryana State Agricultural Marketing Board (HSAMB) / Saral Portal

scheme_name: Promotion of Cotton Cultivation and Desi Cotton Scheme
description: Encourages cotton growers to cultivate indigenous (Desi) cotton varieties and adopt integrated pest management (IPM) practices against pink bollworm.
benefits: Direct cash assistance of ₹3,000 per acre for Desi cotton growers along with subsidized bio-pesticides and pheromone traps.
eligibility: Cotton farmers in major cotton-producing districts of Haryana (Sirsa, Fatehabad, Hisar, Jind, Bhiwani)
Registration on MFMB portal is required
application_mode: Online via Agri Haryana / MFMB Portal

scheme_name: Intensive Fisheries Development & Inland Aquaculture Scheme
description: Provides subsidy for excavating new fish ponds, re-circulatory aquaculture systems (RAS), biofloc units, fish feed, and solar power unit integration for aquaculture.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% subsidy for SC/ST and Women farmers on total unit construction cost and operational inputs.
eligibility: Landowners, lessees, or panchayat land-lessees in Haryana taking up fish farming or shrimp culture in saline water areas
application_mode: Offline / Online via Haryana Fisheries Department Portal
